newsitem.title: JAPAN: Janome up on news of bath unit sales.
newsitem.headline: Janome up on news of bath unit sales.

text.p: Shares of Janome Sewing Machine Co Ltd which also makes bath units, rose on Tuesday morning, prodded by the news that it would continue selling its "24-hour bath" units, brokers said.
As of 0144 GMT, the shares were up 27 yen at 247, the largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.

"Bath unit sales dominate a large part of their profits and they can't just stop selling them," a trader at a medium-sized brokerage said. "From that perspective, our anxieties have not been put to rest and it may take a while for the share prices to stabilise."
On Monday, shares of other top makers of the "24-hour bath" units were hit by reports that some companies had suspended sales of the products due to hygienic concerns.

An official at the Ministry of International Trade and Industry said that Inax Corp, Sekisui Chemical Co Ltd and Hitachi Chemical Co Ltd had suspended sales of "24-hour bath" units after the ministry asked them to check the products' safety.
Janome said later on Monday that it would keep selling its bath units.
